cases.input: Owner Account, multi-role Person and client Organization
cases.expected: Account identity is not Person identity; one Person carries photographer+stylist; Organization is client; exact typed relationship retained.

cases.input: Missing/wrong-Workspace Kind or parent cycle
cases.expected: Location insert/update rejects atomically; every active Location has one same-Workspace active Kind; hierarchy acyclic.

cases.input: Create Beach then beach; canonical/alias order reversed; create beaches
cases.expected: Both extra creations conflict with existing term owner; key beach or beaches is reserved by the same concept; no silent duplicate/upsert.

cases.input: Normalize keys Beach, beach, beaches; aliases explicitly supplied
cases.expected: Keys beach, beach, beaches respectively; plural alias is a claim, not universal English singularization. Fresh creation proposes Beach+beaches together.

cases.input: Merge Studio B into Beach A; promote transferred studios as target canonical
cases.expected: Capture B retirement terms; B merged->A owns zero live claims; A owns beach/beaches/studio/studios exactly once; target canonical studios resolves to A; all live B locations rebind atomically.

cases.input: Concurrent dependent creation during merge, stale expected root or omitted dependent
cases.expected: Reject whole CAS command; no term transfer, partial location rebind, revision increment, receipt-accepted or feed batch.

cases.input: Wrong target transfer, policy/key rewrite, cross-Workspace transfer, unmerge
cases.expected: Reject; only former owner already merged directly into active new owner may transfer unchanged claims.

cases.input: A->B->C merge chain and tombstone of final target
cases.expected: Every current claim belongs only to C; source retirement histories remain; C tombstone retains claims; attempted reclaim/resurrection rejects.

cases.input: Offline new A Beach conflicts with server B Beach
cases.expected: Rejected create remains immutable; explicit reconcile A-absent/B-exact creates historical merged A->B without a second active owner; dependent intents explicitly rebase; package snapshot A untouched.

cases.input: Tombstone Person in current Library with historical package assignment
cases.expected: Person is hidden from active picker; historical snapshot unchanged; no hard-delete cascade; live references require explicit reconciliation.

cases.input: Revision/time/identity corruption and overlapping relationships
cases.expected: Reject stale revision, non-monotonic changed-root revision, created-at/ID mutation, reversed interval and overlapping same-typed relationship interval.

cases.input: Validate clean archive with two commits, two graphs and two selected assets
cases.expected: Every reference/hash/size closes; project owns 2 of 3 discovery candidates; second commit changes only history; external missing bytes are unavailable, not package corruption.

cases.input: Move SMB mount and change device locator
cases.expected: ProjectId/CommitId/object bytes unchanged; update only device binding after identity/checksum verification; stale catalog projection invalidated.

cases.input: Locate no package / same ProjectId at two independent writable paths
cases.expected: Missing remains catalog identity with unavailable locator; duplicate is quarantined for user choice, no newest-timestamp selection or automatic merge.

cases.input: Copy versus explicit fork
cases.expected: Backup copy keeps ProjectId and is not independently writable; fork gives new ProjectId and remaps owned IDs/references with provenance, no silent relabel of source history.

cases.input: Bit flip JSON/blob, missing managed object, truncated HEAD or parent mismatch
cases.expected: Reject claimed verified commit; expose bounded damaged metadata/recovery diagnostics; never repair by inventing digest/history or selecting staged HEAD.

cases.input: Crash before objects, before commit, before HEAD, after HEAD before catalog
cases.expected: Prior HEAD remains authoritative until validated replacement; final case rebuilds projection from new verified HEAD using durable recovery intent.

cases.input: Stale writer, lease timeout, lock owner unknown, SMB disconnect
cases.expected: No time-only takeover; stop publication/reverify; no two-writer success claim; operator-assisted recovery required if ownership uncertain.

cases.input: ../ path, absolute path, symlink, casefold filename alias, oversized reference
cases.expected: Reject path escape/ambiguous object lookup/resource abuse; no external traversal or bookmark resolution from package.

cases.input: Crash after effect intent before response; append interrupted outcome
cases.expected: Attempt/run terminal interrupted, operation knowledge unknown; retries use same operation identity only when provider policy permits; no fabricated provider success receipt.

cases.input: Append reconciliation observation or try changing terminal fact
cases.expected: Observation appends with original OperationId; existing outcome immutable; authored/graph digest unchanged; unknown can persist even after a receipt observation.

cases.input: Missing exact package runtime or optional future node field
cases.expected: Preserve exact 0.0.0 pin and opaque state; diagnostic/no execution; category/search metadata cannot grant code trust or credentials.

cases.input: Offline A/B trace, receipt first and feed first
cases.expected: Exact trace expectations in sync-trace.json; crash/restart preserves intent and overlay; B seals only after A receipt and ordered base application.

cases.input: Same MutationId same bytes after response loss / altered bytes or Account
cases.expected: Authorized exact retry returns same durable body; mismatch is idempotency conflict; revoked or other actor gets no receipt disclosure.

cases.input: Unknown old-epoch sealed request, local supersession or undo
cases.expected: Never blind replay or relabel sealed unknown; unsealed intent may append disposition; accepted undo is a new CAS mutation.

cases.input: 204, duplicate cursor token identity, out-of-order batch, differing digest
cases.expected: 204 changes nothing; identity is target+epoch+sequence; duplicate exact batch no-op; divergent same identity/digest/revision quarantines whole batch without cursor advancement.

cases.input: One root in multi-root batch conflicts/unknown schema
cases.expected: Quarantine entire batch, keep cursor and all roots unchanged; explicit conflict resolution creates new mutation ID and preserves immutable old request/receipt.

cases.input: Snapshot stage/restart/install; local edit during planning; missing known identity
cases.expected: Atomic bounded install replans on local cursor change, preserves overlays/device/recovery; missing known identity is lost_history_conflict, never synthetic tombstone.

cases.input: Expired signing key, retention cut, truncated snapshot, oversized snapshot
cases.expected: snapshot_required or typed limit/unsupported error; no destructive partial reset; no v1 history pruning or silent epoch reset.

cases.input: Stage/finalize thumbnail then replay completion or expired capability
cases.expected: Verify digest/size and authorization; completed object immutable; same completion idempotent; no metadata command carries bytes/credentials or stages over final key.

cases.input: Wrong digest/length, upload unknown outcome, descriptor without local bytes
cases.expected: No verified-ready descriptor before proof; reconcile session after uncertainty; missing local bytes allowed; signed URLs transient/private and not package content.

cases.input: Minimal vs rich cloud observation; foreign Workspace snapshot and device paths
cases.expected: Minimal shares bounded selected summary; rich requires opt-in and same Workspace; omit foreign snapshot details; reject device locator/bookmark fields; report is not verified HEAD.

cases.input: Invalid issuer/audience/signature/expiry, subject not mapped or Account disabled
cases.expected: No Workspace authorization, mutation, receipt lookup or media capability; exact issuer+subject mapping only.

cases.input: Viewer write; removed membership; cross-Workspace ID; forged session scope
cases.expected: API denies before domain write; direct scoped runtime-role SQL has no cross-Workspace rows; forged/stale context denied by authorization helper and RLS.

cases.input: Last owner revocation, role downgrade racing writer, revoked identity
cases.expected: No ownerless live Workspace; defined Account-then-Workspace locking orders outcomes; writes authorized after revocation cannot commit; no claim of deleting already cached offline bytes.

cases.input: API billing mutation, direct identity/private table access, wrong Node capability
cases.expected: Denied by grants/RLS/capability boundary; entitlements do not imply Workspace membership; runtime is never owner/BYPASSRLS.

cases.input: Every byte/count bound at max and max+1, including multibyte UTF-8 and decompression
cases.expected: At-bound valid shape accepted; +1 rejects before expensive allocation and before partial state; atomic command never silently split.

cases.input: Unknown required feature/major or unsupported normalizer/record schema
cases.expected: Read diagnostics safely; no lossy save, partial feed apply or current-cursor advance; optional namespaced fields remain exact semantics.

cases.input: SQLite configured FK/WAL/FULL/busy, acquire/health/version, file persistence
cases.expected: Correct per-connection settings; successful commit persists after pool reopen; rollback/drop prevents visibility; no DB file ever placed on SMB/package.

cases.input: PostgreSQL typed pool lifecycle, commit/rollback and transaction-local scope
cases.expected: Same domain invariants; scope absent on next checkout; no leaked transaction/search_path settings; reconnect errors do not misreport commit certainty.

cases.input: Pool closure, invalid config, busy/timeout, migration checksum drift, secret errors
cases.expected: Bounded typed errors; safe debug/diagnostics redact DSN/tokens/SQL parameters; migration mismatch halts before writes; Storexa remains domain-agnostic.

cases.input: Manual handle/URL; multiple profiles for Person and Organization
cases.expected: No OAuth/network required. Profiles resolve one same-Workspace owner. Rename keeps ProfileId and advances revision; no handle-based Person merge.

cases.input: Bind the same provider/namespace/subject to a different owner, including after tombstone
cases.expected: Reject Workspace-wide subject collision; no second bound owner. Invalid namespace substitution also rejects in typed validation. Manual duplicate handle warns; no silent identity merge.

cases.input: Owner missing/both owners/cross-Workspace; retire owner with live profiles; subject or owner rewrite
cases.expected: Reject invalid ownership and immutable-coordinate changes. Retirement is explicit multi-root profile tombstone; bound subject stays reserved. No clone/reattachment without approved transfer policy.

cases.input: Authorized observation expires/revokes; cached avatar expires; user thumbnail exists
cases.expected: No identity-proof/auth grant inferred; stop unauthorized refresh, invalidate prohibited cache, keep manual facts, fall back to user thumbnail then initials. Durable promotion requires consent plus rights for each use.

cases.input: Tag profile in new Project and upload rich catalog
cases.expected: Use typed Person/Organization assignment and chosen display-only snapshot; no provider subject/tokens/raw responses. No social fields in minimal catalog; rich needs same-Workspace opt-in.

cases.input: Dry-run and side-by-side restore of exact export specimen
cases.expected: Verify all hashes, kinds/parents/social claims/media and report; preserve logical IDs; create new device identity; no auth/sync state restored; no live-store replacement.

cases.input: Corrupt member/wrong key/unsupported version/path escape/oversized archive
cases.expected: Reject before writes or activation; never extract arbitrary paths or run SQL; encryption remains future reviewed-library work.

cases.input: Same ID diverged, Kind alias collision, destination changed after plan
cases.expected: Explicit conflict/reuse/remap report with source provenance; no newest-revision-wins; whole approved unit rolls back or side-by-side activation remains old store; replan on revision change.

cases.input: Restore on new machine; root rebind finds missing/duplicate package
cases.expected: Preserve ProjectId/StorageRootId and safe relative hint; user selects root, verifies package HEAD; missing stays unavailable, duplicate quarantines; packages not included by default.

cases.input: Export expired/provider-restricted avatar, credential/device/sync state or personal-data deletion
cases.expected: Omit disallowed media with completeness report and reject forbidden fields; backups explicitly contain personal data; erasure cannot recall uncontrolled copies; no cache/token/absolute-path leak.
